cases.name: descriptor_inquiry_frozen_capture
cases.scope_note: ALLOCATABLE host values are not captured. Its SIZE freezes the ordinary host work array, which the child mutates before and after descriptor reallocation.

cases.name: grouped_atomic_failure
cases.diagnostic: PRINT format descriptor and item type differ
cases.scope_note: GNU compiles only; intentionally invalid transfer is not executed.

cases.name: list_atomic_cap_failure
cases.scope_note: Unchanged 16MiB list staging cap. GNU compiles only; child failure must preserve only the prior complete record.

cases.name: formatted_atomic_cap_failure
cases.scope_note: Unchanged 65536-character formatted-record cap, below list cap. GNU compiles only.

cases.name: list_larger_than_formatted_cap
cases.scope_note: A 65538-character live-host list record succeeds under the separate 16MiB list cap. The exact oracle includes the leading list-directed blank.

cases.name: allocatable_capture_boundary
cases.scope_note: Standard-valid GNU compile-only; excluded captured host storage kind, not a claim of full closure support.

cases.name: runtime_character_capture_boundary
cases.scope_note: Standard-valid GNU compile-only; excluded captured host storage kind, not a claim of full closure support.

cases.name: pure_transitive_host_write

cases.name: ordinary_transitive_host_write
cases.diagnostic: External side effects inside ordinary functions are unsupported
cases.scope_note: GNU-valid ordinary function effects exceed the bounded interpreter policy. GNU compile-only.

cases.name: readonly_alias_boundary
cases.diagnostic: also referenced through callee host/USE association
cases.scope_note: Conservative whole-storage alias boundary even for a read-only input. GNU compile-only.
